edits.current: Marks the employee's exit. Pairs with the termination date in campo 81 and reduces the contributory days in campos 36 to 39.
edits.proposed: Marks the employee's exit from the systems settled in the return. AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) campo 16 (position 138, one character supplied by the contributor - 'suministrado por el aportante') admits blank, P, R, X, C or T. For a dependent employee the value is X (withdrawal from all the systems settled) in the period in which the termination date falls, and blank in every other period; P reports a withdrawal from the General Pension System only, and R and C apply to independent contributors. T is reported by the contracting party for independent contributors of type 59 in the planilla type Y and never applies to an employee. Pairs with the termination date in campo 81 (T2R2-081), optional under AT2 v30 when RET is reported and always populated by the engine, and drives the contributory days in campos 36 to 39, which run from the first day of the period to the termination date inclusive on the 30-day commercial month (a termination on the last calendar day of the month reports 30 days); the occupational-risk days follow the campo 38 rule (T2R2-038). Source: the termination date of the contract (Contract.End_Date), the same date as the final settlement's termination date and the electronic payroll FechaRetiro (NIE003). A termination processed after the return of its period was paid is reported for that period through a correction return (T2R1-008 = N), not in the period in which the final settlement is paid.

edits.current: Change-event (change event) flag. Populated only in the month the event occurs, and only for the employee it affects. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 become mandatory, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Permitted values are blank, P, R, X or C. Where marked, the engine populates 'Termination date' (T2R2-081) with the termination date (AT2 v30 campo 81 makes the date optional when RET is reported; the engine's own interlock requires it).
edits.proposed: Change-event flag, CONDITIONAL: blank is permitted by the layout; populated only in the period in which the termination occurs, and only for the employee it affects. Permitted values are blank, P, R, X, C or T (AT2 v30 (MinSalud, Res. 2388/2016 Anexo Técnico 2, version 30, 24-07-2026) campo 16, position 138); for a dependent employee only X applies, and T is reported by the contracting party for independent contributors of type 59 in the planilla type Y, never for an employee. The whole change event block T2R2-015 to T2R2-030 is mutually constraining: the flag drives which of the date fields T2R2-080 to T2R2-097 are populated, and it drives the day counts in T2R2-036 to T2R2-039. Where marked, the engine populates 'Termination date' (T2R2-081) with the termination date (AT2 v30 campo 81 makes the date optional when RET is reported; the engine's own interlock requires it).
